journey.name: Lingua end-to-end
journey.description: Verifies translating, source-language detection, history persistence, the API editor's connection test, theme switching and error reporting against the local mock endpoint.

actions.action: Launch Lingua from the launcher
Verify the Translate screen is shown with a source text field and a Translate button
Tap the example suggestion "The early bird catches the worm."
Tap the Translate button
Verify the translation "早起的鸟儿有虫吃。" is displayed
Verify a detected-language label "English" is displayed next to the source field
Open the History tab
Verify the entry "The early bird catches the worm." is listed under "Today"
Type "bird" into the history search field
Verify the entry is still listed
Replace the search text with "zzz"
Verify the empty state "No matches" is displayed
Clear the search field
Favorite the entry
Swipe the entry from right to left to delete it
Verify the "Deleted" snackbar appears with an Undo action
Tap Undo
Verify the entry is listed again
Force-stop Lingua and launch it again from the launcher
Open the History tab
Verify the entry is still listed and still marked as a favorite
Open the Settings tab
Verify the endpoint card "Mock" is shown and marked as active
Tap Edit on the endpoint card
Verify the editor is titled "Edit endpoint" and the base URL field contains "http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1"
Tap "Test connection"
Verify a success result is shown with a latency in milliseconds
Tap "Test translation"
Verify the response contains "你好，世界！"
Change the model field to "error-401"
Tap "Test connection"
Verify the result reports failure with an HTTP 401 message
Change the model field back to "mock-translate"
Tap Save
Verify the Settings screen shows the endpoint card "Mock" with model "mock-translate"
Set the theme to "Light"
Verify the interface is rendered in light colors and all text remains readable
Set the theme back to "Follow system"
